maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new equipment sales: street sweepers, sewer cleaners, hydroexcavators, dump truck bodies, and safety signals; parts and service are the smaller share.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are municipal and also industrial, contractor and dealer buyers; no clear majority is government-funded, though sweepers and sewer cleaners go to municipalities.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through organic equipment sales and products, with periodic bolt-on acquisitions (TBEI, OSW, Deist, GFW) rather than a continuous roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Customers can buy equivalent sweepers, vacuum trucks or truck bodies from competitors; switching costs are moderate, mostly retraining and parts.

notes: Government share of revenue is uncertain; municipal sales are large but the mix with industrial customers is unclear.
